Title: Orbital
Description: Some names need no introduction. Orbital is one of those. For anyone who spent their nights on the dancefloor in the ‘90s, between stroboscopes and smoke machines, and made slightly over-optimistic plans for the next work day, this feels like returning home. The Hartnoll brothers took electronic music from the clubs to major venues and, along the way, wrote classics that still pack a punch to this day. Don’t expect a nostalgic show, but rather a band that still looks forward and proves live why they belong among the absolute best of British electronica. What’s more, Saturday 1 May is the perfect night to avoid having to head straight off to the office the next morning. So put that imaginary smiley face on one more time, relive the ‘90s and surrender to the pulsating beats, mesmerising visuals and that unmistakable Orbital vibe.

Title: The Cat Empire + Little Quirks
Description: Since their formation in Melbourne in 1999, The Cat Empire have been touring the world with a catchy mix of ska, jazz, funk, reggae and Latin. With a strong horn section, danceable rhythms and a generous dose of enthusiasm, the Australians have become a much-loved live band. Since 2023, the group has continued with a revamped line-up centred around founders Felix Riebl and Ollie McGill. Following appearances at Glastonbury and six sold-out shows in their home country at the legendary Sydney Opera House, they are returning to Europe in 2027 with their eleventh studio album, Bells of Midnight, which is due for release on 9 April.

Title: Ão
Description:
The sun on your skin, a heart full of longing and rhythms that sweep you away between Brussels, Lisbon and Maputo. In the spring of 2027, Ão returns to AB with one of the most distinctive live shows of the moment.

With their unique blend of electronica, art pop, Afro-pop, saudade and alternative Latin, Ão have emerged in recent years as one of the most exciting bands on the Belgian music scene. Their second album, Malandra, marked their definitive breakthrough in 2026, with rave reviews, a sold-out show at Ancienne Belgique, a completely sold-out club tour and more than 80 shows across Europe.

Centred around frontwoman Brenda Corijn, who draws on her Mozambican-Portuguese roots and sings in Portuguese and English, Ão creates a mesmerising universe in which warm melodies, layered electronica and rousing grooves blend effortlessly. Live, the band shifts between fragile intimacy and irresistible danceability, always with that characteristic blend of melancholy and euphoria.

In April 2027, ‘Obra’, a new EP that completes the story of ‘Malandra’, will be released. The first single, ‘Sofrimento’ – a reworking of a track by Waldemar Bastos – showcases how Ão are further deepening their Portuguese, African and electronic influences.

Title: Robbing Millions
Description:
Robbing Millions is the alter ego of Belgian musician Lucien Fraipont . Just like avant-pop greats Todd Rundgren and Scritti Politti , Fraipont is a wizard when it comes to original melodies.

His path to Robbing Millions was as meandering as the music itself: Lucien was active on the Belgian jazz scene and played with various bands over the years, including Aksak Maboul , Das Pop and Amatorski . When he started experimenting with recording software at home, he discovered just how rewarding it could be to create music on his own.

After brilliant double album Holidays Inside – the first external release on MGMT Records (label of MGMT members Andrew VanWyngarden and Ben Goldwasser ) – came the critically acclaimed Rêve Party . Then Robbing Millions released another collection of musical gems on the B-Sides EP (2016–2018) , but things have been quiet since then.

Fortunately, that’s now set to change in the spring of 2027 with See You Again , the first single from their fourth album, due for release on Brussels’ Capitane Records. Melancholy, yet irresistibly groovy: a combination that has gradually become a trademark for Robbing Millions.

Title: Ax and the Hatchetmen
Description: Ax and the Hatchetmen from Chicago started out in 2018 as a group of friends at music school, but have since grown into one of the freshest young rock bands around. The six musicians got to know each other whilst studying jazz, but their sound defies easy categorisation, ranging from rock, soul and funk to pop. The genres clash cheerfully with one another. In 2025, their debut album So Much To Tell You, produced by Jake Sinclair (Panic! At The Disco, Weezer), was released, featuring, amongst other tracks, the viral hit “Hotel Room”.

Title: Vitalic
Description:
VERTICA is the title of Vitalic ’s new album. It is conceived as a sensory and introspective journey. Faced with digital excess and the homogenisation of musical creation, Vitalic chose to rediscover his inspiration whilst travelling through Europe. He captured sounds, images and sensations to fuel his creative process. The album explores three musical universes: euphoric and danceable electropop, a darker, rock-inspired post-EBM dimension, and contemplative and transcendental moments. Through twelve tracks, VERTICA tells a personal story blending energy, introspection and emotion, with a true sonic and visual coherence.

On stage, the project will take the form of a two-part show: a first part featuring two musicians, influenced by new wave and disco, followed by a second, more radical and hypnotic solo piece. Curious? So are we!

Title: Brainstory
Description:
Brainstory are based in Los Angeles, but originally hail from Rialto, California. There, brothers Kevin and Tony Martin played music in the same way they approached skateboarding and punk rock: as something unpolished, something you experience together and keep entirely under your own control. Later, Eric Hagstrom joined them, driven by a shared love of jazz. What began as a trio that spoke the language of improvisation gradually evolved into a band that managed to absorb the lessons of jazz without being bound by its conventions. The album Money Jungle – the legendary 1962 collaboration between Duke Ellington, Charles Mingus and Max Roach – was a crucial influence. To them, this jazz sounded like the same rebellious energy that had so appealed to them in punk. It proved that improvisation can be confrontational, physical and liberating. The foundations of Brainstory were laid in the interplay between formal jazz training and hard graft on the local club circuit. Their band was further strengthened by countless hours on the road and the recording of various studio albums, released via the New York-based label Big Crown Records , under the guidance of producer and label boss Leon Michels .

Their early records were primarily the work of a young band still learning how to translate their live energy into a studio recording.

Title: Gelukkig Zijn Sessie @ Nekkersdal
Description:
This session will take place at GC Nekkersdal, Boulevard Emile Bockstael107, 1020 Brussels. Doors open at 09:30 and we’ll start singing at 10:00. The session is scheduled to end at 11:30.

Do you want to improve your Dutch and do you enjoy singing? Then you’ve come to the right place! Every month, accompanied by two musicians and a set list full of Dutch-language classics, we head to a different community centre in Brussels. There, we practise Dutch together.... through singing!

Through Dutch-language songs, you’ll get to know the language better in a fun and accessible way. At the same time, you’ll discover more about Belgian culture and meet new people. Three birds with one stone!

And don’t worry: you don’t need to be Ann Christy or Clouseau. Fun and enthusiasm are what matter most. You don’t need to be a talented singer!

We’ll provide a pianist, a lead singer, the song lyrics and a free drink. Everyone is welcome and the sessions are free . Registration is required, though.

Take a look at our schedule and find out when we’ll be singing near you. Fancy warming up your vocal cords in the meantime? Check out this season’s setlist here !

In collaboration with the Taalunie , Theater van A tot Z and the Flemish Community Commission (VGC).

Title: L' Entourloop
Description:
Founded in Saint-Étienne in 2013, L’Entourloop is a French collective led by Sir Johnny and King James, blending reggae, hip-hop and sound system culture into their distinctive « Hip-Hop Inna Yardie Style ». Known for their collaborations with international artists, the group has amassed hundreds of millions of streams and performed over 1,000 shows worldwide.

Renowned for their immersive live performances combining music, visuals and vintage aesthetics, L’Entourloop is preparing its fourth studio album, scheduled for early 2027, followed by a brand-new international tour and immersive live show.

Title: Isabèl Usher
Description: Isabèl Usher , who was born in England and grew up in Assen (the Netherlands), began her career as a songwriter for artists such as Kris Kross Amsterdam and Rolf Sanchez, but eventually decided to step into the spotlight herself. She made her breakthrough on TikTok with ‘Ik Kom Weer Thuis’, followed by her debut album Astronaut (2024) and appearances at festivals including Lowlands and Pinkpop. On her second album, Meisje Van Het Noorden (2026), she combines personal, vulnerable lyrics with energetic electronic music and British drum-and-bass influences. With hits such as ‘Niemand Wil Een Popster’ and ‘Spijt Komt Later’ (featuring Kraantje Pappie) and two sold-out tours under her belt, she’s ready for her biggest Belgian shows to date!

Title: Yasmine Hamdan
Description: The Lebanese artist Yasmine Hamdan , acclaimed for her unique fusion of Arabic sounds and Western electronica, delivers a spellbinding live show brimming with mysticism, emotion and rhythm, carried by a voice that sounds both traditional and elusive modern. Yasmine Hamdan made her breakthrough with the duo Soapkills and has since collaborated with leading international producers such as Mirwais (Madonna) and Marc Collin (Nouvelle Vague). Her music is as much a tribute to the rich Arab vocal tradition as it is a fresh reinvention of it. Drawing on influences from pop, folk and electronica, she creates a timeless, boundary-crossing sound that has made her a fixture at festivals such as Glastonbury, Meltdown and Sziget. Following the albums Ya Nass and Al Jamilat, both of which received worldwide acclaim and airplay from the BBC to NPR, Hamdan returns with I Remember I Forget, an intimate, powerful album brimming with melancholy, rebellion and feminine strength. Live, her work translates into a compelling experience in which music, language and atmosphere merge into a hypnotic whole, as she demonstrated once again last summer at Gent Jazz.

Title: Svaneborg Kardyb
Description:
In 2023, the Danish electronic jazz duo Svaneborg Kardyb – that is to say, Nikolaj Svaneborg and Jonas Kardyb – impressed us during an AB Club concert as part of the celebrations marking the 15th anniversary of Gondwana Records, run by Mancunian Matthew Halsall. So it’s time for a concert of their own!

Svaneborg Kardyb draws as much inspiration from Danish folk music as from the rich tradition of Scandinavian jazz. Think of Esbjörn Svennson as well as Jan Johansson’s landmark 1964 album Jazz På Svenska – an absolute must-listen! – as points of reference. With Superkilen (2024) and Over Tage (2022), they have already released two albums on Gondwana Records. The latter, incidentally, received a **** review in Mojo, whilst BBC Radio 3 raved: “Their sound floats and twinkles like it’s from another place … there’s myth and magic there” .

What can we expect Svaneborg Kardyb? We are gearing up with a series of special live performances across Europe, featuring brand new music alongside material from our previous releases. The shows will feature lighting and scenography by Vertigo, the Copenhagen-based audiovisual artist collective known for their inventive light installations, stage designs and immersive experiences.”

Finally, a Gondwana Records nerd alert: in 2028, AB will be celebrating the label’s 20th anniversary, and we’ll soon be announcing Phi-Psonics, who specialise in contemporary spiritual jazz.

Title: Sanguijuelas del Guadiana
Description:
This is a Liveurope concert, the first European initiative that supports concert venues in promoting emerging musical talent from Europe.

From the village of Casas de Don Pedro in Extremadura come Carlos , Juan and Víctor , the three friends behind Sanguijuelas del Guadiana . When they returned to their birthplace in Spain, they decided to make music together. Their roots form the basis for a unique sound in which they combine various influences with raw energy, catchy melodies and a good dose of rock 'n’ roll.

Their lyrics are about everyday life: village celebrations, dusty streets, the Guadiana river, friendship, love and the feeling of being caught between two different worlds. Because what does it mean to leave your village and yet end up longing for home? Their songs are full of recognisable stories, with a mix of nostalgia, rebellion and humour.

It all comes together on their debut album Revolá (2025). The album tells the tale of a generation that sought its way between the countryside and the city, between leaving and returning, between new dreams and old familiar places. Sanguijuelas del Guadiana’s fresh sound and infectious energy provide a unique twist to Spanish rock.

Title: Marka solo
Description: Come celebrate his 66th birthday and his 46-year career. Marka will be performing solo on the AB stage! He’ll be unveiling new songs, accompanied only by his trusty old acoustic guitar. And rest assured, he’ll also be performing the songs that made him famous. A final challenge for this young old man—a return to basics. Come cheer on Marka, alone facing himself, his songs, and his audience, in the venue where it all began for him with “ Allez Allez ” in 1981.

Title: The Subs
Description:
For twenty years now, The Subs have been setting Belgian and international dancefloors alight. Since their breakthrough with ‘Kiss My Trance’, the Ghent-based band have become pioneers of the Belgian electro scene, with a mix of electro, rave, techno and punk attitude. Think of classics such as ‘The Pope of Dope’ and ‘Music Is the New Religion’, but above all their legendary, high-energy live shows, as they recently demonstrated at Pukkelpop.

The Subs are celebrating their twentieth anniversary with ‘Two Decades of Dance’, an album due for release on 23 April. The first single from the album is ‘Sowieso’, a raw ode to Antwerp featuring Roméo Elvis, OGENN, Bhavi and Kleine Crack.

Title: Lambrini Girls + Taqbir
Description:
With their raw charisma, biting humour and explosive energy, Lambrini Girls leave no one indifferent. The British duo are set to build on their momentum with the release of their new album, ‘No Refunds’, on 15 January 2027, followed by a tour of the same name.

With their uncompromising message, fuelled by anger that is as legitimate as it is unifying, Phoebe Lunny and Selin Macieira-Boşgelmez have quickly established themselves as the voices of a generation. A band that some – from online trolls to those who espouse all forms of discrimination – would have preferred never to see emerge, but one that the world sorely needed. With their debut album, Who Let The Dogs Out, released in 2025, the Brighton-based duo have enjoyed a meteoric rise. From a Top 20 entry on the UK album charts to features on leading publications such as Kerrang! and NME, and sold-out tours across the globe, their music has struck a chord they could never have imagined. The band has also received praise from icons such as Kathleen Hanna (Bikini Kill), Iggy Pop and Sleater-Kinney, and has shared the stage with IDLES, Amyl & The Sniffers and many others.

15 January 2027 will mark the release of their second album, ‘No Refunds’.Darker, more direct and even more radical, this new album fits perfectly into an era where half-measures no longer have a place. Its themes address the great evils of our time, from fascism to the growing ubiquity of artificial intelligence.
